fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry headline/articleBody-style fields spread verbatim from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss, the site's default RSS feed) carry title/link-style fields only -- no byline/author field is exposed by either source.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-jsonld (article page NewsArticle block), S2-rss (default RSS feed), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description/summary. Present on both article-mode records (NewsArticle JSON-LD) and latest-mode RSS items.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article body (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle -- this site's ld+json is unusually complete and includes the full text, not just a teaser).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Article keywords/tags (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: Article language code (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Publish timestamp (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified timestamp (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Site section/category the article belongs to (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text (latest mode; from the default RSS feed <title> element).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL (latest mode; from the default RSS feed <link> element).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Feed item GUID (latest mode; from the default RSS feed <guid> element).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: Publish timestamp as a raw RSS date string (latest mode; from the default RSS feed <pubDate> element). Note: the default feed is not strictly chronological -- sort/filter by this field if a strict time window is needed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
